links.comparator_used: Human coder consensus ratings as reference standard (no head-to-head comparison against sampled-only human review)
links.outcome: Concordance of automated conversation-level risk classification with expert human ratings across 8 risk categories
links.effect: Accuracy >0.90 for all categories; specificity uniformly high; sensitivity range 0.55-1.00; kappa 0.65-1.00
links.tradeoff: Sensitivity varied by category, with a low of 0.55 for some risk behaviors; tested only on 100 synthetic conversations.
links.quote: ASTRA demonstrated consistently high concordance with expert human ratings across all categories.
